lines.zh: 我的身体像一座会走的炉子。
lines.en: My body is like a walking furnace.

lines.zh: 我一动，炉膛里的火就响。
lines.en: When I move, the fire in my belly roars.

lines.zh: 我的腿很沉，每步都留焦痕。
lines.en: My legs are heavy; each step leaves a scorch.

lines.zh: 我从熔岩池旁经过，没停。
lines.en: I pass a lava pool without stopping.
I walk toward wherever it's hot.

lines.zh: 我的影子在红光里拉长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches in the red glow.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但地面都在响。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and the ground rings.
I knock the blocking rocks aside.
The air trembles where I've passed.

lines.zh: 我不需要路，我能踩出来。
lines.en: I need no path; I make one.
I stand, my furnace door opening and closing.
My breathing is fire drawing air.
I burn, and have never gone out.
I swallow coal, and the fire grows.

lines.zh: 我听见下界很远有哭声。
lines.en: I hear crying far off in the Nether.

lines.zh: 我的外壳裂着，红光从缝里漏。
lines.en: My shell is cracked, red light leaking out.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，地面烫了一块。
lines.en: I crouch, and the ground burns.
I needn't sleep; I need only burn.
I watch the lava flow slowly.
I heat a rock until it glows.
Little sparks rise from my vent.

lines.zh: 我记得被点着的那一天。
lines.en: I remember the day I was lit.
I raise a hand; my palm is a furnace.
I listen to the sound of myself burning.
I draw my legs together to save heat.
It's too cold around here; I dislike it.
I'm hot; don't touch.
There's sweat on your face; I see it.
I lower my head, firelight on you.
You shouldn't come to a place like this.
I smell coal on you.
You backed off; wise.

lines.zh: 我的手举起来，你别误会。
lines.en: I raise a hand; don't misread it.
Your boot soles are softening.

lines.zh: 我站在这儿，就是一道门。
lines.en: Standing here, I am a door.
You want to get past me?
My eyes are two lumps of fire.
I turn your way, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的外壳掉了一块，里面更亮。
lines.en: A shell piece falls; the inside is brighter.
I sway, and my flame dips.

lines.zh: 这一下打在炉壁上，很闷。
lines.en: That hit my furnace wall, muffled.
I step back, scorching the ground.
I stoke the fire to hold my heat.
I don't cry out; a cry would be fire.
I look down at the split.
You can move me; that's uncommon.
My vent sputters once.
I'm still burning; don't rush.
The smell of coal; my favorite.

lines.zh: 你手里那块，烧起来很好。
lines.en: That piece in your hand would burn well.
I smell something burnable.
Give it to me, and I'll burn brighter.
I lean toward your hand.
I open my furnace door and wait.
Drop it in; I'll burn it myself.
My fire's low; I need fuel.
Come a little closer and let me smell.

lines.zh: 你的木头也能烧，我知道。
lines.en: Your wood burns too; I know.
You hit me and recoil from the heat.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一堵炉墙。
lines.en: I don't move; I'm a furnace wall.

lines.zh: 你的护甲贴上来，烫出了印。
lines.en: Your armor touches me and takes a scorch mark.

lines.zh: 我侧身，你从我旁边滑下去。
lines.en: I turn, and you slide off my side.

lines.zh: 我不需要推你，烫就够了。
lines.en: I needn't push; the heat is enough.

lines.zh: 我的外壳被撞掉一块，里面更烫。
lines.en: A shell piece breaks off; the inside is hotter.

lines.zh: 你退开时，地上留了脚印。
lines.en: When you pull back, your prints smoke.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，火星溅了满天。
lines.en: We collide, and sparks fill the air.
I block the narrow way; there's no passing.

lines.zh: 你跳开了，我慢慢转过来。
lines.en: You leap away; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 另一座炉子也在这里烧。
lines.en: Another furnace burns here too.

lines.zh: 我们并排，火合成一大片。
lines.en: Side by side, our fires merge into one.

lines.zh: 她烧得比我旺，也比我会省。
lines.en: She burns hotter, and she's thriftier.
We share the coal.

lines.zh: 我们的炉门一开一合，很齐。
lines.en: Our furnace doors open and close in step.

lines.zh: 她递给我一块熔融的煤。
lines.en: She hands me a lump of molten coal.

lines.zh: 我们不需要话，热就够了。
lines.en: We need no words; the heat suffices.
Two vents face each other, brightly lit.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，地面就化开。
lines.en: We lean together, and the ground melts.
She remembers the day she was lit too.
I pick up coal and crumble it.
I scoop up lava and drink it.

lines.zh: 我把你的剑捡起来，烧软。
lines.en: I pick up your sword and soften it in my heat.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块岩石，抛着玩。
lines.en: I pick up a rock and toss it.
I melt the fallen iron ingot.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的盾，边缘化了。
lines.en: I pick up your shield; its rim melts.

lines.zh: 我把地上的余烬拢进炉里。
lines.en: I sweep the embers into my furnace.
I pick up blackstone; it's light.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的地图烧了个角。
lines.en: I burn a corner of your dropped map.

lines.zh: 我拾起一具残骸，当柴烧。
lines.en: I pick up a wreck to burn as fuel.
You've come near my vent.
I'm starting to heat up.
My vent is aimed at you.
You're carrying things that burn well.
You've stepped into my ring of heat.
I see your shadow retreating.
The heat here answers to me.
I raise a hand, and the furnace flares.
You brought the fuel I need.
I don't chase; the fire does.
The ground you stand on is melting.
I've taken this path to cut you off.

lines.zh: 你听见轰声了吗？那是炉膛。
lines.en: Hear that roar? That's my furnace.
I come from here; stop hiding.
I count to three, then open up.
Your shadow is already on fire.
I don't tire, and neither does the fire.
This whole place will burn clean.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走过来，很慢。
lines.en: I come step by step, slowly.
The ground turns red beneath me.

lines.zh: 我把石头烧成流的东西。
lines.en: I burn stone until it runs.
You run; I heat up.
My furnace door opens and closes.
Sparks chase you on the wind.

lines.zh: 你躲到石柱后，石柱在软。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar; it's softening.
I'm in no hurry; fire finds its own way.
My body starts turning white-hot.
Even your breath comes out hot.

lines.zh: 我把手放在地上，火爬过去。
lines.en: I set a hand down, and fire crawls out.

lines.zh: 你退到岩壁边，没有路了。
lines.en: You back to the wall; no path left.
My vent stays aimed at you.
I'm waiting for the furnace to fill.
Do you hear that low roar?
I've burned the whole path red.
Your boot soles are smoking.
I needn't move yet.
Run as fast as you like; the heat finds you.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地裂开冒火。
lines.en: I smash down, and the crack vents fire.
My palm presses you, searing.

lines.zh: 我抬手，一道火柱冲起来。
lines.en: I raise a hand, and a pillar of fire rises.
I shove you to the lava's edge.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，带着一身火星。
lines.en: I charge, trailing sparks.

lines.zh: 我的炉门全开，火舌扫过。
lines.en: My door opens wide, and flame sweeps out.

lines.zh: 这一下把石头烧成了粉。
lines.en: That turned the stone to powder.
You block once, and your armor glows red.
I catch your wrist; it's hot.

lines.zh: 火从地上冒出来，包住你。
lines.en: Fire rises from the ground and wraps you.
I kick you away, sparks following.
One step in, and the ground quakes.

lines.zh: 这一击我留着炉膛的火。
lines.en: I saved the furnace's fire for this.

lines.zh: 你身上的水汽一下就没了。
lines.en: The moisture on you vanishes at once.

lines.zh: 岩浆边上，我慢慢站起来。
lines.en: At the lava's edge, I rise slowly.
I was lit, and never went out.

lines.zh: 下界的空气里，我最好受。
lines.en: I'm most at home in the Nether's air.

lines.zh: 我的炉膛第一次烧起来。
lines.en: My furnace burns for the first time.

lines.zh: 地面被我踩出焦黑的圈。
lines.en: My feet leave a ring of scorched black.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在很远的地方走。
lines.en: I hear someone walking far off.

lines.zh: 我身上的裂缝一条条亮起。
lines.en: The cracks along my body light up one by one.
I know these rock walls.
I press a hand into lava to draw fire.
I raise my head, and sparks drift up.

lines.zh: 我的炉门响了一声，开了。
lines.en: My furnace door clanks once and opens.
I stand here like a wall.
Someone lit a fire, so I came.

lines.zh: 我的影子在红光里很长。
lines.en: My shadow is long in the red light.

lines.zh: 我不需要路，我能开一条。
lines.en: I need no road; I can make one.

lines.zh: 这片地方的石头都在响。
lines.en: The stones here are all ringing.

lines.zh: 我呼出的第一口气是火。
lines.en: My first breath out is fire.

lines.zh: 我记得我原来是块石头。
lines.en: I remember I was once a stone.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了一圈，看这地方。
lines.en: I turn once to look the place over.
I've come, and I don't plan to leave.
Fire is mine; you can't melt me.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，落地时炸开一圈火。
lines.en: I fall, and a ring of fire bursts on landing.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，白汽冲得很高。
lines.en: Water hits me, and steam shoots up.

lines.zh: 爆炸和我炉膛里的火撞在一起。
lines.en: The blast meets the fire in my furnace.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进来，立刻烧没了。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in and burns away at once.
A spell presses my fire down.
Without coal, my fire weakens.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，和炉火一起响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, roaring with my furnace.

lines.zh: 这里没有热，我一点点冷下去。
lines.en: There's no heat here; I cool bit by bit.
